name: send_paperwork
description: Send the full bail bond paperwork packet (SignNow) to the caller for e-signature. Call after collecting caller name, email, defendant name, and county. Optional surety_id routes OSI vs Palmetto templates.

caller_name.description: Full name of the indemnitor / caller

caller_email.description: Email address to receive signing invites

caller_phone.description: Caller mobile for SMS signing link (optional but recommended)

defendant_name.description: Full name of the defendant in jail

county.description: Florida county where the defendant is held

surety_id.description: Optional surety company for template routing. Default osi. Use palmetto only when the bond is written on Palmetto Surety.

notes: Netlify proxies to GAS source=send_paperwork with ELEVENLABS_TOOL_SECRET
GAS handleShannonSendPaperwork resolves Palmetto template IDs via _resolveTemplateId
